pr_title: [release] Add GLM5 known issue for 2-node PD mixed deployment
source_quote: 了更准确的 release notes 描述，补充了 prefix cache 在 hybrid model 中最小 token 数与 tp size 的关系说明。

rule.description: Release notes 中描述已知问题或行为变更时，应提供具体的技术细节（如与 tp size 的关系）和数值示例（如 tp 2 时 block_size 为 2048），帮助用户准确理解影响范围。

antipattern.code:
## v0.17.0rc1

### Known Issues

- The minimum number of tokens of prefix cache hit in hybrid model is large now.
- DeepSeek V3.2 may hang in 2-node PD mixed deployment when concurrency > 8.
  Fixed in PR #7235 and PR #7290.

### New Features

- Support for Qwen3.5 model family

pattern.code:
## v0.17.0rc1

### Known Issues

- The minimum number of tokens of prefix cache hit in hybrid model is large now. The exact number is related to tp size, e.g., with tp 2, the block_size is adjusted to 2048, which means that any prefix shorter than 2048 will never be cached.
- DeepSeek V3.2 may hang in 2-node PD mixed deployment when concurrency > 8.
  Fixed in PR #7235 and PR #7290.

### New Features

- Support for Qwen3.5 model family
